title: Lectures start at a quarter past

text: At many German universities lectures are announced with c.t. (cum tempore, "with time"). A lecture listed at 10 c.t. starts at a quarter past ten, which leaves time to change rooms. A lecture listed with s.t. (sine tempore) starts exactly on the hour. Always check the timetable.
Cambridge works similarly: a lecture at ten usually starts at five past.
